looking.title: Looking for your vehicles
looking.body: Rivolt is checking your Rivian account. This usually takes a few minutes, and your vehicles show up here when it is done.

none.title: No vehicles on this Rivian account yet
none.body: Your Rivian account is connected, but it lists no vehicle. Rivolt looks again about once a day.

reauth.title: Reconnect your Rivian
reauth.body: Rivian needs you to sign in again before Rivolt can look for your vehicles.
